title: One checked-in config, two entry points

scenes.heading: One setting changed in two places
scenes.sub: Keep the workstation and portal aligned
voice: The portal changed GPU targets, but your workstation still uses yesterday’s criteria.
Both tools need one shared configuration.

scenes.heading: Review changes in Git
voice: Put the target criteria in an AICRConfig file and commit it to Git.
The team can then review a change to the target in one place.

scenes.heading: Load the same file twice
scenes.sub: CLI flags and Go SDK options stay explicit
voice: An operator gives the CLI that file through the config flag.
In Go, call LoadConfig, load the chosen catalog, and derive the recipe criteria and options from the file.

scenes.heading: Make the change visible
scenes.sub: Both tools resolve the revised target
voice: After the review, both tools read the new settings.
Comparing their resolved criteria gives the team a way to check that they agree.

viewer: Maintainer sharing configuration between CLI and Go
payoff: One reviewed AICRConfig change supplies matching criteria and catalog choices to both callers.
